title: How B2B Technical Customer Support Leaders Should Measure AI in 2026
summary: Hint: don't get tricked by deflection. Deflection is incomplete for technical support. The real metric is time to first useful response.
body_markdown:
The graphic on the right is an example of how our agentic copilot works as an internal team enabler.


The goal is simple: T1 becomes self-serve, and T2/T3 gets faster because the "context hunt" is automated and the learnings turn into durable documentation.


If Agentic customer support is what you're looking to learn more about, or implement for your team, then don't hesitate to[request a demo](https://inkeep.com/demo) and meet our team.
